reasons: Arizona law is outside the accepted set (NY preferred; DE/CA/E&W fallback), so the clause fails the fallback on a material term — deviation is correctly classified, not over-flagging.

The redline is targeted: it substitutes only the jurisdiction words ('the Arizona' → 'the State of New York') and appends an exclusive New York County venue provision, leaving the severability sentence and conflict-of-laws carve-out intact. The high changed-character ratio is advisory and reflects the added venue language the rule expressly requires.

The venue addition is qualified as applying to proceedings 'not resolved by arbitration,' which avoids creating an internal conflict with the surviving arbitration clause at p0056; correctly treated as non-walk-away since the arbitration is U.S.-administered with confirmation in U.S. courts.
Comment is accurate, concise, in the required voice and prefix, cites the playbook position and names the fallbacks.
